identity.not_to_confuse_with: FYSETC AIO II (STM32) - nothing from it applies
identity.origin: 3D-printer all-in-one controller, RAMPS 1.4 compatible (Arduino Mega 2560 + RAMPS on one PCB)
identity.profile_description: Treat as a generalised CNC / motion controller, not a 3D printer. Heater, bed and fan outputs are unused and must stay off. TEMP0 thermistor is attached to the X stepper driver chip, TEMP1 thermistor to the X stepper motor, to monitor the effect of the X current setting.

status_tags.R: RAMPS 1.4 standard, consistent with tests but not individually confirmed
status_tags.F: confirmed from vendor firmware disassembly, not exercised electrically
status_tags.?: unknown or guessed - verify before relying on it

fuses.meaning: full-swing crystal, BOOTRST, 512-word (1 KB) boot section, JTAG off, SPIEN, EESAVE off, BOD 2.7 V; lock: app cannot write or read the boot section

memory_map.use: aiready descriptor block, 16 KB (this data). Never written by app uploads; rewritten on its own by 'aiready write-descriptor'
Optiboot bootloader (1 KB boot section, lock-protected). Never write

programming.bootloader: Optiboot (MegaCore optiboot_flash, ATmega2560 UART0 115200 16 MHz, BIGBOOT, LED on D13). Installed by ISP 2026-11-19 (replaced the 2013 'stk500V2 by MLS' bootloader)
programming.upload: USB via bootloader (STK500v1); ISP (USBasp) only to change the bootloader or fuses
programming.entry: Only after an external reset (DTR auto-reset or RESET button), ~1 s timeout. Power-on and watchdog resets start the app directly
quirks: Optiboot erases each page it writes, so partial images are safe; app uploads must still not reach 0x3BC00 (descriptor).
A byte that is not a valid STK500 command during the bootloader window causes a 16 ms watchdog reset into the app: it is lost, nothing hangs.
MCUSR reaches the app unchanged (also in r2). The HAL reports it as the reset cause.
Watchdog resets go straight to the app, no bootloader delay [V]; no app-size limit (Optiboot uses jmp 0) [R].
programming.readback: Flash and EEPROM can be read back through the bootloader (aiready readback)
programming.tool: host/aiready: 'aiready flash <hex>' backs up, strips protected regions, uploads, verifies

host_link.open_without_reset: Open with DTR and RTS disabled, and close with both disabled in the saved port config (rewrite the DCB, e.g. re-apply the baud rate). Otherwise the next DTR-disabled open makes a short DTR pulse that resets the board once (app back after ~1 s). host/aiready does this.
host_link.bootloader_window_rule: After a reset the bootloader listens ~1 s; the app banner follows. Bytes sent before the banner are lost (they make Optiboot restart into the app), so wait for the banner before sending.
host_link.runtime_protocol: Send '@ai <cmd>' lines; runtime answers with one JSON line whose "r" names the command. Commands: id, desc <off> <len>, state, watch <ms>, pins, peek <addr> <n>, safe, clear, reboot, help. Boot banner: {"r":"banner",...}

current.set_by: hardware trimpot only; firmware cannot change it
current.formula: Itrip = Vref / 0.4  (Vref = 0.4 x I); measure Vref on pot wiper vs GND

trimpots.note: X has no pot; probably shares Y pot (same current as Y)

steppers.monitoring: X axis: TEMP0 = driver chip temperature, TEMP1 = motor temperature (profile cnc-poc-1)

endstops.connector: S + GND (+5 V needs jumper/solder change for optical)
endstops.switch_type: NO to GND assumed; NC would read always triggered
endstops.triggered_level: LOW for NO switch to GND
endstops.reuse: X and Z inputs suit counters, encoders, tachometers (hardware INT)

power_outputs.type: N-MOSFET low side, load voltage = Vin
power_outputs.profile_state: unused and forced LOW in cnc-poc-1
power_outputs.rules: OUTPUT LOW first in setup(); never INPUT_PULLUP; any heating needs thermistor fault detection + runaway/max-on cutoff

thermistors.circuit: 4.7k pull-up to 5 V, NTC to GND, ~10 uF filter (RAMPS standard)
thermistors.model: 100k NTC, B=3950 assumed (reads ~28 C at room temp)

thermal_guard.action: X driver disabled (ENABLE HIGH), fault latched until '@ai clear' or app call
thermal_guard.note: A4988 thermal shutdown ~165 C junction; package surface reads lower than junction

display.bus: hardware SPI mode 0, <=4 MHz, shared with SD
display.not: NOT the RAMPS ST7920 wiring (D16/D17/D23 unused)

u8g2.why: without 0xA0 the image is mirrored and wraps

beeper.drive: square wave 2-4 kHz; 2000/2700/4000 Hz audible; loudest unknown
beeper.hal: aiBeep(ms, hz=2700), aiToneStart(hz)/aiToneStop(): Timer3 CTC ISR toggles PC0

spi.rule: one context only; deselect the other device

timers.use: millis/delay; COMPA used by aiready encoder poll
aiready beeper while sounding, else free

timers.rule: can generate Z steps in hardware

resources.no_interrupts: ports A, C (encoder), F, G (Y endstops), L
fast_paths: X_STEP and Y_STEP both on PORTF: pulse together with one write

user_config.effect: set A4988 current limit, Vref = 0.4 x I
jumper/solder change to provide 5 V for optical endstops
TEMP0 on X driver, TEMP1 on X motor

limits.mcu_powered_from_usb_alone: logic works; motors and outputs need Vin
limits.cooling: no heatsinks/fan on drivers assumed; ~1 A RMS practical

safety_rules.rule: First lines of setup(): D10, D8, D9 OUTPUT LOW; ENABLE 38, 56, 62, 24 OUTPUT HIGH. aiSafeInit() does this.
Never set MOSFET gate pins (8, 9, 10) to INPUT_PULLUP.
Any heater control must include thermistor open/short detection and thermal-runaway / max-on-time cutoff.
Do not drive D4, D6, D7 HIGH until identified.
No tone(): it takes Timer2 (heater/fan PWM).
Never write flash at or above 0x3BC00 from an app (descriptor block, bootloader).
Keep the X thermal guard enabled while X is energised (profile cnc-poc-1).
Before any motion command check state.drivers_enabled: a driver may already be energised (by the user or another tool).

unknowns: Which trimpot sets X current (shared with Y?) and present Vref values
ESP-01 UART and its 3.3 V supply
What D4, D6, D7 connect to
MOSFET and fuse ratings; 5 V regulator capacity
Which DIR level moves each axis toward its MIN endstop
Possible TEMP0/TEMP1 crosstalk: TEMP1 varied 26-30 C while TEMP0 was open

api: aiSafeInit()  - call first in setup(); safe state + reset-cause
AiReady.begin("name", "version")  - banner + runtime; AiReady.poll() every loop()
AiReady.onLine(cb)  - receive serial lines that are not '@ai' commands
aiTempC(ch) / aiTempRead(ch, &t)  - thermistor C with fault code; ch AI_T_X_DRIVER / AI_T_X_MOTOR
AiEncoder::begin(), position(), button()  - polled at 1 kHz
aiStepperEnable(axis, on), aiStepperMove(axis, steps, steps_per_s, stop_on_endstop)  - blocking; refuses X while guard tripped
aiBeep(ms, hz=2700), aiToneStart(hz), aiToneStop()  - passive buzzer via Timer3
aiDisplayBegin(u8g2)  - aiready_display.h, needs olikraus/U8g2 in lib_deps
hal.serial_rule: Apps share Serial with the runtime: do not consume lines starting '@ai'; use AiReady.onLine().
